definitions.explanation: Medicine that can only be obtained with a doctor's prescription, as opposed to over-the-counter medication.

examples.japanese: {処方薬|しょほうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらい→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to the pharmacy to pick up my prescription.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{処方薬|しょほうやく}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処方箋|しょほうせん}→処方箋：06496_shohousen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: This medicine is a prescription drug, so you need a doctor's prescription.

examples.japanese: {処方薬|しょほうやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{用法|ようほう}→用法：13541_youhou⟧・⟦{用量|ようりょう}→用量：18412_youryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}って→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}して→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take prescription medicine correctly, following the prescribed dosage and instructions.

notes: In Japan, prescription medicines are dispensed at ⟦{調剤薬局|ちょうざいやっきょく}→調剤薬局：29876_chouzaiyakkyoku⟧ (dispensing pharmacies) separate from the hospital. The doctor writes a ⟦{処方箋|しょほうせん}→処方箋：06496_shohousen⟧ (prescription), which the patient takes to a pharmacy. Contrasts with ⟦{市販薬|しはんやく}→市販薬：09834_shihanyaku⟧ (over-the-counter medicine) and {一般用医薬品|いっぱんよういやくひん} (general-use pharmaceuticals). The verb pattern is {処方薬|しょほうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ or {処方薬|しょほうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to prescribe medication).
